# TCP route configuration entry reference

This topic provides reference information for the gateway TCP routes configuration entry. Refer to [Route Resource Configuration](/consul/docs/reference/k8s/api-gateway/routes) for information about configuring API gateways in Kubernetes environments.

## Configuration model

The following list outlines field hierarchy, language-specific data types, and requirements in a `tcp-route` configuration entry.

- `Kind`: string | must be `"tcp-route"`
- `Name`: string | no default
- `Namespace`: string | no default <EnterpriseAlert inline />
- `Partition`: string | no default <EnterpriseAlert inline />
- `Meta`: map | no default
- `Services`: list | no default
  - `Name`: string | no default
  - `Namespace`: string | no default <EnterpriseAlert inline />
  - `Partition`: string | no default <EnterpriseAlert inline />
  - `TLS`: map | no default
    - `SDS`: map | no default
      - `ClusterName`: string | inherited from listener/gateway TLS SDS cluster when omitted
      - `CertResource`: string | required when `SDS` is configured
  - [`Limits`](#services-limits): map | none
    - [`MaxConnections`](#services-limits-maxconnections): number | none
    - [`MaxPendingRequests`](#services-limits-maxpendingrequests): number | none
    - [`MaxConcurrentRequests`](#services-limits-maxconcurrentrequests): number | none
    - [`PassiveHealthCheck`](#services-limits-passivehealthcheck): map | none
      - [`Interval`](#services-limits-passivehealthcheck-interval): string | none
      - [`MaxFailures`](#services-limits-passivehealthcheck-maxfailures): number | none
      - [`Consecutive5xx`](#services-limits-passivehealthcheck-consecutive5xx): number | none
      - [`ConsecutiveGatewayFailure`](#services-limits-passivehealthcheck-consecutivegatewayfailure): number | none
      - [`EnforcingConsecutive5xx`](#services-limits-passivehealthcheck-enforcingconsecutive5xx): number | none
      - [`EnforcingConsecutiveGatewayFailure`](#services-limits-passivehealthcheck-enforcingconsecutivegatewayfailure): number | none
      - [`MaxEjectionPercent`](#services-limits-passivehealthcheck-maxejectionpercent): number | none
      - [`BaseEjectionTime`](#services-limits-passivehealthcheck-baseejectiontime): string | none
- `Parents`: list | no default
  - `Kind`: string | must be `"api-gateway"`
  - `Name`: string | no default
  - `Namespace`: string | no default <EnterpriseAlert inline />
  - `Partition`: string | no default <EnterpriseAlert inline />
  - `SectionName`: string | no default

## Complete configuration

When every field is defined, a `tcp-route` configuration entry has the following form:

<CodeTabs>

```hcl
Kind = "tcp-route"
Name = "<name of the route>"
Namespace = "<enterprise: namespace of the route>"
Partition = "<enterprise: partition of the route>"

Meta = {
  "<any key>" = "<any value>"
}

Services = [
  {
    Name = "<name of service>"
    Namespace = "<enterprise: namespace of the service>"
    Partition = "<enterprise: partition of the service>"
    TLS = {
      SDS = {
        ClusterName = "<optional SDS cluster name>"
        CertResource = "<required SDS certificate resource>"
      }
    }
    Limits = {
      MaxConnections = <number>
      MaxPendingRequests = <number>
      MaxConcurrentRequests = <number>
      PassiveHealthCheck = {
        Interval = "<time between ejection analysis sweeps>"
        MaxFailures = <number>
        EnforcingConsecutive5xx = <percentage>
        MaxEjectionPercent = <percentage>
        BaseEjectionTime = "<base ejection duration>"
      }
    }
  }
]

Parents = [
  {
    Kind = "api-gateway"
    Name = "<name of the api-gateway to bind to>"
    Namespace = "<enterprise: namespace of the parent>"
    Partition = "<enterprise: partition of the parent>"
    SectionName = "<listener on the api-gateway to bind to>"
  }
]
```

```json
{
  "Kind": "tcp-route",
  "Name": "<name of the route>",
  "Namespace": "<enterprise: namespace of the route>",
  "Partition": "<enterprise: partition of the route>",
  "Meta": {
    "<any key>": "<any value>"
  },
  "Services": [
    {
      "Name": "<name of service>",
      "Namespace": "<enterprise: namespace of the service>",
      "Partition": "<enterprise: partition of the service>",
      "TLS": {
        "SDS": {
          "ClusterName": "<optional SDS cluster name>",
          "CertResource": "<required SDS certificate resource>"
        }
      }
      "Limits": {
        "PassiveHealthCheck": {
          "Interval": "<time between ejection analysis sweeps>",
          "MaxFailures": <number>,
          "EnforcingConsecutive5xx": <percentage>,
          "MaxEjectionPercent": <percentage>,
          "BaseEjectionTime": "<base ejection duration>"
        },
        "MaxConnections": <number>,
        "MaxPendingRequests": <number>,
        "MaxConcurrentRequests": <number>
      }
    }
  ],
  "Parents": [
    {
      "Kind": "api-gateway",
      "Name": "<name of the api-gateway to bind to>",
      "Namespace": "<enterprise: namespace of the parent>",
      "Partition": "<enterprise: partition of the parent>",
      "SectionName": "<listener on the api-gateway to bind to>"
    }
  ]
}
```

</CodeTabs>

## Specification

This section provides details about the fields you can configure in the `tcp-route` configuration entry.

### `Kind`

Specifies the type of configuration entry to implement. This must be set to `"tcp-route"`.

#### Values

- Default: none
- This field is required.
- Data type: string value that must be set to `tcp-route`.

### `Name`

Specifies a name for the configuration entry. The name is metadata that you can use to reference the configuration entry when performing Consul operations, such as applying a configuration entry to a specific cluster.

#### Values

- Default: none
- This field is required.
- Data type: string

### `Namespace` <EnterpriseAlert inline />

Specifies the Enterprise [namespace](/consul/docs/multi-tenant/namespace) to apply to the configuration entry.

#### Values

- Default: `"default"` in Enterprise
- Data type: string

### `Partition` <EnterpriseAlert inline />

Specifies the Enterprise [admin partition](/consul/docs/multi-tenant/admin-partition) to apply to the configuration entry.

#### Values

- Default: `"default"` in Enterprise
- Data type: string

### `Meta`

Specifies an arbitrary set of key-value pairs to associate with the route.

#### Values

- Default: none
- Data type: map containing one or more keys and string values.

### `Services[]`

Specifies the TCP service that the API gateway routes incoming requests to.

#### Values

- Default: none
- Data type: list of maps with these fields:
  - `Name`
  - `Namespace` <EnterpriseAlert inline />
  - `Partition` <EnterpriseAlert inline />
  - `TLS`
  - `Limits`

**Note:** `tcp-route` currently supports a maximum of one service.

### `Services[].Name`

Specifies the TCP-based service to route to.

#### Values

- Default: none
- Data type: string

### `Services[].Namespace` <EnterpriseAlert inline />

Specifies the Enterprise [namespace](/consul/docs/multi-tenant/namespace) where the service is located.

#### Values

- Default: `"default"` in Enterprise
- Data type: string

### `Services[].Partition` <EnterpriseAlert inline />

Specifies the Enterprise [admin partition](/consul/docs/multi-tenant/admin-partition) where the service is located.

#### Values

- Default: `"default"` in Enterprise
- Data type: string

### `Services[].TLS`

Specifies service-level TLS settings for this TCP route service.

#### Values

- Default: none
- Data type: map

### `Services[].TLS.SDS`

Specifies SDS certificate selection for this route service.

#### Values

- Default: none
- Data type: map

### `Services[].TLS.SDS.ClusterName`

Specifies the SDS cluster used to fetch the certificate resource.

#### Values

- Default: inherits the effective listener SDS cluster (`Listeners[].TLS.SDS.ClusterName`, falling back to top-level `api-gateway.TLS.SDS.ClusterName`)
- Data type: string

### `Services[].TLS.SDS.CertResource`

Specifies the SDS certificate resource name for this route service.

#### Values

- Default: none
- This field is required when `Services[].TLS.SDS` is set.
- Data type: string

### `Services.Limits`

Specifies upstream circuit-breaker limits for the routed destination service.

These values override any gateway-level defaults configured in the parent [`api-gateway` configuration entry](/consul/docs/reference/config-entry/api-gateway#defaults). If the same upstream service is referenced by multiple routes or listeners attached to the same gateway, Consul applies the lowest non-zero value for each limit when generating the shared Envoy cluster.

#### Values

- Default: none. If unspecified, Consul uses the gateway-level default for the same field when available. Otherwise the proxy default applies.
- Data type: Map that can contain the following fields:
  - [`MaxConnections`](#services-limits-maxconnections)
  - [`MaxPendingRequests`](#services-limits-maxpendingrequests)
  - [`MaxConcurrentRequests`](#services-limits-maxconcurrentrequests)
  - [`PassiveHealthCheck`](#services-limits-passivehealthcheck)

### `Services.Limits.MaxConnections`

Specifies the maximum number of upstream connections this routed service is allowed to establish.

#### Values

- Default: none. If unspecified, Consul uses [`Defaults.MaxConnections`](/consul/docs/reference/config-entry/api-gateway#defaults-maxconnections) when available.
- Data type: Integer

### `Services.Limits.MaxPendingRequests`

Specifies the maximum number of requests that are allowed to queue while waiting to establish an upstream connection.

The attached API gateway listener must use an L7 protocol such as `http`, `http2`, or `grpc` for this configuration to take effect.

#### Values

- Default: none. If unspecified, Consul uses [`Defaults.MaxPendingRequests`](/consul/docs/reference/config-entry/api-gateway#defaults-maxpendingrequests) when available.
- Data type: Integer

### `Services.Limits.MaxConcurrentRequests`

Specifies the maximum number of concurrent upstream requests that are allowed at a single point in time.

The attached API gateway listener must use an L7 protocol such as `http`, `http2`, or `grpc` for this configuration to take effect.

#### Values

- Default: none. If unspecified, Consul uses [`Defaults.MaxConcurrentRequests`](/consul/docs/reference/config-entry/api-gateway#defaults-maxconcurrentrequests) when available.
- Data type: Integer

### `Services.Limits.PassiveHealthCheck`

Specifies the passive health check for this routed destination service. Passive health checks configure Envoy outlier detection, which removes service instances that return consecutive errors from the gateway's load balancing pool.

This value replaces the [`Defaults.PassiveHealthCheck`](/consul/docs/reference/config-entry/api-gateway#defaults-passivehealthcheck) value configured in the parent `api-gateway` configuration entry for this service. Consul does not merge individual fields from the gateway default into this value. When multiple routes or listeners attached to the same gateway reference the same upstream service with different passive health checks, Consul applies only one of them to the shared Envoy cluster. Configure the same passive health check for a service across all routes on a gateway.

The map can contain the following fields:

- [`Interval`](#services-limits-passivehealthcheck-interval)
- [`MaxFailures`](#services-limits-passivehealthcheck-maxfailures)
- [`Consecutive5xx`](#services-limits-passivehealthcheck-consecutive5xx)
- [`ConsecutiveGatewayFailure`](#services-limits-passivehealthcheck-consecutivegatewayfailure)
- [`EnforcingConsecutive5xx`](#services-limits-passivehealthcheck-enforcingconsecutive5xx)
- [`EnforcingConsecutiveGatewayFailure`](#services-limits-passivehealthcheck-enforcingconsecutivegatewayfailure)
- [`MaxEjectionPercent`](#services-limits-passivehealthcheck-maxejectionpercent)
- [`BaseEjectionTime`](#services-limits-passivehealthcheck-baseejectiontime)

Refer to [`Defaults.PassiveHealthCheck`](/consul/docs/reference/config-entry/api-gateway#defaults-passivehealthcheck) in the API gateway configuration reference for more information about the gateway default.

#### Values

- Default: none. If unspecified, Consul uses [`Defaults.PassiveHealthCheck`](/consul/docs/reference/config-entry/api-gateway#defaults-passivehealthcheck) when available. Otherwise, Envoy uses its default outlier detection settings.
- Data type: Map

### `Services.Limits.PassiveHealthCheck.Interval`

Specifies the time between outlier detection analysis sweeps. Each sweep can eject hosts from the load balancing pool or return them to the pool.

#### Values

- Default: none. Envoy uses `10s`.
- Data type: String duration, such as `"10s"`. The value cannot be negative.

### `Services.Limits.PassiveHealthCheck.MaxFailures`

Specifies the number of consecutive `5xx` errors that cause Envoy to eject a host from the load balancing pool.

#### Values

- Default: none. Envoy uses `5`.
- Data type: Integer

### `Services.Limits.PassiveHealthCheck.Consecutive5xx`

Specifies the number of consecutive `5xx` errors that cause Envoy to eject a host. When set, this value overrides `MaxFailures`.

#### Values

- Default: none
- Data type: Integer greater than `0`

### `Services.Limits.PassiveHealthCheck.ConsecutiveGatewayFailure`

Specifies the number of consecutive gateway failures, such as `502`, `503`, or `504` errors, that cause Envoy to detect an outlier. Envoy ejects the host only when `EnforcingConsecutiveGatewayFailure` is greater than `0`.

#### Values

- Default: none. Envoy uses `5`.
- Data type: Integer greater than `0`

### `Services.Limits.PassiveHealthCheck.EnforcingConsecutive5xx`

Specifies the percent chance that Envoy ejects a host when it detects an outlier status through consecutive `5xx` errors. Use this setting to turn off ejection or ramp it up gradually.

#### Values

- Default: none. Envoy uses `100`.
- Data type: Integer from `0` to `100`

### `Services.Limits.PassiveHealthCheck.EnforcingConsecutiveGatewayFailure`

Specifies the percent chance that Envoy ejects a host when it detects an outlier status through consecutive gateway failures.

#### Values

- Default: none. Envoy uses `0`, which turns off ejection for consecutive gateway failures.
- Data type: Integer from `0` to `100`

### `Services.Limits.PassiveHealthCheck.MaxEjectionPercent`

Specifies the maximum percentage of hosts in the upstream cluster that Envoy can eject at the same time. Envoy ejects at least one host regardless of the value.

#### Values

- Default: none. Envoy uses `10`.
- Data type: Integer from `0` to `100`

### `Services.Limits.PassiveHealthCheck.BaseEjectionTime`

Specifies the base amount of time that an ejected host stays out of the load balancing pool. The actual ejection time equals the base ejection time multiplied by the number of times Envoy has ejected the host, up to a maximum of `300s`.

#### Values

- Default: none. Envoy uses `30s`.
- Data type: String duration, such as `"30s"`. The value cannot be negative.

### `Parents[]`

Specifies the list of gateways that the route is bound to.

#### Values

- Default: none
- Data type: list of maps with the following fields:
  - `Kind`
  - `Name`
  - `Namespace` <EnterpriseAlert inline />
  - `Partition` <EnterpriseAlert inline />
  - `SectionName`

### `Parents[].Kind`

Specifies the type of resource to bind to. This field is required and must be set to `"api-gateway"`.

#### Values

- Default: none
- This field is required.
- Data type: string

### `Parents[].Name`

Specifies the name of the API gateway to bind to.

#### Values

- Default: none
- This field is required.
- Data type: string

### `Parents[].Namespace` <EnterpriseAlert inline />

Specifies the Enterprise [namespace](/consul/docs/multi-tenant/namespace) where the parent is located.

#### Values

- Default: `"default"` in Enterprise
- Data type: string

### `Parents[].Partition` <EnterpriseAlert inline />

Specifies the Enterprise [admin partition](/consul/docs/multi-tenant/admin-partition) where the parent is located.

#### Values

- Default: `"default"` in Enterprise
- Data type: string

### `Parents[].SectionName`

Specifies the name of the listener in the parent [`api-gateway` configuration entry](/consul/docs/reference/config-entry/api-gateway). If this field is empty, the route binds to all listeners on the parent gateway.

A `tcp-route` can only bind to API gateway listeners that use the `tcp` protocol. To route traffic from listeners that use the `http`, `http2`, or `grpc` protocol, use an [`http-route`](/consul/docs/reference/config-entry/http-route).

#### Values

- Default: `""`
- Data type: string

## TLS SDS behavior and precedence

For certificate selection, Consul applies this order:

1. `tcp-route` service `Services[].TLS.SDS`
2. API gateway listener `Listeners[].TLS.SDS`
3. API gateway top-level `TLS.SDS`

Additional behavior:

- If `Services[].TLS.SDS` is set, `CertResource` must be provided.
- For TCP routes, hostnames are not required for service-level SDS.
- If `ClusterName` is omitted at service level, it is inherited from listener or gateway SDS.
- A TCP listener can only have one distinct effective service override; conflicting overrides on the same listener are rejected.

## Example: inherit listener/gateway SDS cluster

```hcl
Kind = "tcp-route"
Name = "tcp-route-inherit"

Parents = [
  {
    Kind = "api-gateway"
    Name = "api-gateway"
    SectionName = "tcp"
  }
]

Services = [
  {
    Name = "payments"
    TLS = {
      SDS = {
        CertResource = "payments.internal.example.com"
      }
    }
  }
]
```

## Example: explicit service SDS cluster override

```hcl
Kind = "tcp-route"
Name = "tcp-route-explicit"

Parents = [
  {
    Kind = "api-gateway"
    Name = "api-gateway"
    SectionName = "tcp"
  }
]

Services = [
  {
    Name = "orders"
    TLS = {
      SDS = {
        ClusterName = "local_sds_cluster"
        CertResource = "orders.internal.example.com"
      }
    }
  }
]
```
